description: AWS: route the 7 cache-bypassing client methods in AwsClientProvider through the existing clientCache (computeIfAbsent), so each AWS SDK v2 client is built once and reused instead of leaking an sdk-ScheduledExecutor thread per call. Independent of FEAT-002 (Azure) and FEAT-003 (GCP) — different files.
steps: Read xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/AwsClientProvider.java and src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/AwsClientProviderWriteClientTest.java first (and context.json). Follow the existing clientCache/computeIfAbsent, getClient(...), and HOST:/ROLE: key patterns exactly.
getPricingClient() (~line 552): cache on fixed key 'HOST:PricingClient:us-east-1' via clientCache.computeIfAbsent, keeping Region.US_EAST_1 and the no-credentials builder (mirror getHostS3Client).

getSavingsplansClient(CloudAccount account, String region) (~line 674): route through getClient(SavingsplansClient.class, SavingsplansClient.builder(), account, region) — identical override via getClientOverrideConfig, like getRdsClient.

getEksClientForTokenGeneration(CloudAccount account) (~line 404): keep region resolution System.getenv().getOrDefault("AWS_REGION","us-east-1"); cache on key 'HOST_TOKEN:EksClient:'+region via computeIfAbsent, keeping getCredentialsProvider(account) + getClientOverrideConfig(account,"EksClient",region). Add a one-line comment that this key is not evicted per customer account.

getHostCloudWatchClient(String region) (~line 283): cache on key 'HOST:CloudWatchClient:'+region with DefaultCredentialsProvider; keep the existing try/catch + log by doing create/log inside the computeIfAbsent lambda and wrapping the computeIfAbsent call in the same try/catch and RuntimeException message style.

getHostDynamoDbClient() (~line 246): cache on fixed key 'HOST:DynamoDbClient:ap-south-1'. Do NOT cache static assume-role creds (they expire). Build the cached client ONCE with an auto-refreshing StsAssumeRoleCredentialsProvider.builder().stsClient(stsClient).refreshRequest(req -> req.roleArn("arn:aws:iam::982534352845:role/XamOps-AutoSpotting-HostRole").roleSessionName("XamOps-AutoSpotting-HostDynamo")).build(), region Region.AP_SOUTH_1; keep the same RuntimeException error handling/message. This removes the per-call stsClient.assumeRole round-trip.

getRoleAthenaClient(roleArn, externalId, region) (~line 350): cache the CLIENT on key 'ROLE:AthenaClient:'+roleArn+':'+region via computeIfAbsent; keep the already-cached getRoleCredentialsProvider for creds.
getRoleS3Client(roleArn, externalId, region) (~line 358): cache the CLIENT on key 'ROLE:S3Client:'+roleArn+':'+region via computeIfAbsent.

Add a short comment near the new HOST:/HOST_TOKEN:/ROLE: keys noting evictAccount (removes awsAccountId+':' prefixed keys) does not evict these — acceptable, not per-customer-account clients. Do NOT touch withPermissionTracking, getClientOverrideConfig, getFinOpsClientOverrideConfig, evictAccount, getCostExplorerClient, getBudgetsClient, or any already-cached method.

Add a new test class xamops-service/src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/AwsClientProviderCachingTest.java mirroring AwsClientProviderWriteClientTest (mock StsClient + AwsPermissionInterceptor). Assert second call isSameAs first for getPricingClient(), getHostCloudWatchClient(region), getHostDynamoDbClient(), getRoleAthenaClient(arn,extId,region), getSavingsplansClient(account,region). For getHostDynamoDbClient, also assert stsClient.assumeRole is not called eagerly (creds now refresh lazily inside the provider).
acceptance_criteria: All 7 named methods obtain their client via clientCache.computeIfAbsent (no path builds a fresh client on every call).
getHostDynamoDbClient uses an auto-refreshing StsAssumeRoleCredentialsProvider on a single cached client and no longer calls stsClient.assumeRole per invocation.
Regions, credentials providers, and overrideConfiguration for each method are unchanged from before.
Running mvn -q -pl xamops-service -am test -Dtest=AwsClientProviderCachingTest passes, and AwsClientProviderWriteClientTest still passes.
findings: Implemented in worktree .worktrees/thread-leak-fix (branch thread-leak-fix), commit on that branch. All 7 cache-bypassing methods now route through clientCache.computeIfAbsent: getSavingsplansClient -> getClient(SavingsplansClient...); getPricingClient -> key 'HOST:PricingClient:us-east-1'; getEksClientForTokenGeneration -> key 'HOST_TOKEN:EksClient:'+region; getHostCloudWatchClient -> key 'HOST:CloudWatchClient:'+region (computeIfAbsent lambda inside the existing try/catch, same RuntimeException message); getHostDynamoDbClient -> key 'HOST:DynamoDbClient:ap-south-1' built once with an auto-refreshing StsAssumeRoleCredentialsProvider (no more per-call stsClient.assumeRole; the old static-cred/AssumeRoleRequest path is gone); getRoleAthenaClient -> key 'ROLE:AthenaClient:'+roleArn+':'+region; getRoleS3Client -> key 'ROLE:S3Client:'+roleArn+':'+region. getRoleCredentialsProvider (ROLE_CREDS) left as-is. withPermissionTracking/getClientOverrideConfig/getFinOpsClientOverrideConfig/evictAccount/getCostExplorerClient/getBudgetsClient untouched; regions/creds/overrides unchanged. Removed now-unused imports AwsSessionCredentials, StaticCredentialsProvider, AssumeRoleRequest, AssumeRoleResponse (no other refs in the file). NOTE for later steps: HOST:/HOST_TOKEN:/ROLE: keys are NOT evicted by evictAccount (which only removes awsAccountId-prefixed keys) by design (not per-customer clients) — commented in code. New test: xamops-service/src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/AwsClientProviderCachingTest.java (6 tests, mirrors WriteClientTest; the CloudWatch test stubs stsClient.getCallerIdentity()). Verification: 'mvn -q -pl xamops-service -am compile' OK; 'mvn -pl xamops-service -am test -Dtest=AwsClientProviderCachingTest,AwsClientProviderWriteClientTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false' => Tests run: 13, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, BUILD SUCCESS. The -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false flag is required because -am also builds permissions-common where the -Dtest pattern matches nothing. FEAT-002 (Azure) and FEAT-003 (GCP) touch different files and remain independent.
